name: Ledger from Tanaris
summary: In Searing Gorge, a small job from Tanaris now waits for you. Krinkle Goodsteel of Gadgetzan wants several things gathered here and elsewhere, then brought to him.

sections.title: A Job from Tanaris
sections.body: The person inside the wooden outhouse has been helped and remembers a small job from Tanaris. Krinkle Goodsteel of Gadgetzan wants several things gathered, some in Searing Gorge and others farther away. The ledger will be slid beneath the door. Carry it and everything listed to Goodsteel in Tanaris.

sections.title: What the Ledger Lists
sections.body: Goodsteel's ledger calls for twenty solid crystal leg shafts from the glassweb spiders of Searing Gorge. It also lists an overdue package at the crashed zeppelin in Beezil's Wreck, in Dustwallow Marsh. The third item is Goodsteel's balanced flameberge. Jarquia, a murloc along the eastern shore of the Swamp of Sorrows, has it.

faq.answer: It begins at the wooden outhouse in Searing Gorge, after you help the person locked inside.
Krinkle Goodsteel is in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris. He says he is awfully busy, with many patrons asking for his services.
The ledger lists twenty solid crystal leg shafts, an overdue package, and Goodsteel's balanced flameberge.
The overdue package lies at the crashed zeppelin at Beezil's Wreck, in Dustwallow Marsh.
Jarquia, a murloc along the eastern shore of the Swamp of Sorrows, has Goodsteel's balanced flameberge.
Caught! came before this, at the same wooden outhouse.
